name: Wallpaper Daemon & Visual Backgrounds
shortDesc: Paints wallpapers, animated GIFs, or dynamic transitions across your displays.
detailedDesc: Runs in the background layer-shell without interfering with application windows.

phase.title: Desktop Shell & Core Plumbings
phase.description: Status bars, launchers, notification systems, on-screen displays, and wallpaper managers.

packages.name: swww (Recommended)
packages.description: Efficient Wayland wallpaper daemon written in Rust supporting smooth transition effects (wipe, wave, grow, fade) and animated GIFs.
cons: Slightly more complex CLI parameters than static hyprpaper

packages.name: hyprpaper
packages.description: Blazing-fast, lightweight static wallpaper utility from the official Hyprland project.
cons: Static wallpapers only; no wipe/wave animated transition effects

packages.name: mpvpaper
packages.description: Video wallpaper utility utilizing mpv hardware video decoding as a live desktop background.
pros: Full live video loops (MP4, MKV) as desktop wallpaper
cons: Consumes more GPU and battery power on laptops

packages.name: Waypaper (GUI Wallpaper Picker)
packages.description: Graphical wallpaper selector frontend that sits on top of swww or hyprpaper.
cons: GUI utility rather than background daemon
